verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own site claims it runs on a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM 'with room to spare', and ships Foot as a fast, lightweight default terminal. A hands-on user also ran it on a €30 low-end Chromebook with a 32GB SSD, though the official ISO install failed there and they had to fall back to archinstall. Missing for 10: documented minimum hardware requirements, any evidence of better performance compared with other OSes, any evidence on extending device lifespan, and a reliable ISO install path on low-end hardware.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get better performance and extended device lifespan by installing the OS on older hardware

citations.quote: Even a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM can run Omarchy, with room to spare.
Foot is the fast, lightweight default.
Installed Omarchy on a €30 N23 Chromebook with a 32GB SSD.
